memories.title: Separate connection pool per upstream
memories.content: Each upstream service gets its own egrpc_channel_pool so one slow upstream cannot exhaust connections for the others.

memories.title: Use gRPC deadlines, not socket timeouts
memories.content: Set a deadline on every call; the server cancels work when it passes. Socket-level timeouts are left at their defaults.

memories.title: ETIMEDOUT during pool warm-up
memories.content: Starting the pool before the upstream DNS record exists produces ETIMEDOUT and the pool never retries on its own.

memories.title: badarg from ets after a supervisor restart
memories.content: ETS tables owned by a crashed process vanish; callers then get badarg until the owner is restarted and recreates the table.

memories.title: Hot code upgrade checklist
memories.content: Build the appup file, run relup in staging, and confirm that no process holds state in an old record layout.

memories.title: No blocking calls in gen_server callbacks
memories.content: A gen_server callback must not make a synchronous call to another busy server; use a cast or a task instead.

memories.title: Error code E1042
memories.content: E1042 means the request body exceeded the 4 MiB message limit configured on the channel.

memories.title: Error code E2007
memories.content: E2007 means the caller's token lacks the scope required by the method.

memories.title: Retry only idempotent calls
memories.content: The client retries a failed call up to twice, but only when the method is marked idempotent in the protobuf options.

memories.title: Rotate service certificates
memories.content: Issue the new certificate, deploy it next to the old one, wait for all clients to reload, then remove the old one.

memories.title: Large messages and memory
memories.content: Streaming a 100 MB response into a single binary doubles memory use; stream in chunks instead.

memories.title: Mnesia is not used for session data
memories.content: Session data lives in Redis because mnesia schema changes are hard to roll out across nodes.

memories.title: Rate limit per tenant
memories.content: Each tenant is limited to 200 requests per second; excess requests get RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED.

memories.title: Health endpoint
memories.content: The /health endpoint returns 200 only when the pool has at least one ready channel.

memories.title: Log sampling hides errors
memories.content: With 1 percent log sampling, rare error classes can disappear from dashboards; always log errors unsampled.

memories.title: Reproduce a flaky test
memories.content: Run the test 200 times with a fixed random seed, then bisect by removing concurrent tests.

memories.title: Telemetry event names
memories.content: Event names use the form egrpc.client.<event>.<measurement>, never dynamic values in the name.

memories.title: Supported OTP versions
memories.content: The library is tested against the two latest OTP major releases.

memories.title: No atoms from user input
memories.content: Never call binary_to_atom on request data; use binary_to_existing_atom or keep binaries.

memories.title: Backpressure on streams
memories.content: A server-streaming handler that ignores send errors keeps producing after the client left, wasting CPU.

memories.title: Capture a crash dump
memories.content: Set ERL_CRASH_DUMP to a writable directory and analyse it with the crashdump viewer.

memories.title: Semantic versioning
memories.content: Breaking protobuf changes bump the major version; field additions bump the minor version.

memories.title: Default pool size
memories.content: The default pool holds 8 channels per upstream, configurable with the pool_size option.

memories.title: DNS caching
memories.content: Channel resolution is cached for 30 seconds, so a changed record is picked up only after that.

memories.title: 灰度发布比例
memories.content: 新版本先放百分之五的流量，观察错误率半小时后再扩大到一半。

memories.title: 时钟回拨
memories.content: 虚拟机迁移后系统时钟可能回拨，依赖单调时间以外的超时判断会提前触发。

memories.title: 排查进程内存增长
memories.content: 先用 observer 查看按内存排序的进程，再检查是否有进程邮箱持续积压。

memories.title: 禁止在循环里建立连接
memories.content: 不允许在请求处理循环里新建数据库连接，必须从连接池借用。

memories.title: 数据库连接池大小
memories.content: 数据库连接池大小设为核心数的两倍，超出的请求排队等待而不是新建连接。

memories.title: 备份与恢复演练
memories.content: 每季度做一次数据库恢复演练，记录耗时和遇到的问题。

memories.title: protobuf 字段编号复用
memories.content: 删除字段后不能复用编号，旧客户端会把新数据解析成错误的类型。

memories.title: 回滚失败的发布
memories.content: 发现错误率上升时先切回上一个版本，再分析日志，不要在线上直接修补。

memories.title: 告警分级
memories.content: 只有影响用户的故障才会呼叫值班人员，其余告警进入工作日处理队列。

memories.title: 值班交接
memories.content: 值班交接在周一上午进行，交接文档记录未关闭的告警和已知风险。

memories.title: 滚动更新丢请求
memories.content: 滚动更新时如果就绪探针过早通过，新实例会在预热完成前收到流量。

memories.title: 配置不得硬编码
memories.content: 超时、重试次数和限流阈值必须来自配置，代码里不能写死。

memories.title: 压测流程
memories.content: 压测前先冻结其他变更，使用生产数据的脱敏副本，逐步提高并发直到延迟超标。

memories.title: 日志格式
memories.content: 日志使用 JSON 一行一条，必须包含请求编号和租户编号。

memories.title: 服务等级目标
memories.content: 核心接口的可用性目标是百分之九十九点九，延迟 p99 低于三百毫秒。

memories.title: 重试风暴
memories.content: 下游故障时所有客户端同时重试会放大流量，重试必须带随机抖动。

memories.title: 代码仓库布局
memories.content: 核心库在 apps 目录，示例和压测脚本放在 tools 目录。

memories.title: 接口幂等键
memories.content: 写操作要求客户端传入幂等键，服务端保存二十四小时用于去重。

memories.title: channel_pool 的 checkout 超时
memories.content: egrpc_channel_pool 的 checkout 等待超过 500 毫秒就返回 pool_exhausted，不无限排队。

memories.title: gen_server:call 默认超时
memories.content: gen_server:call 默认 5 秒超时，调用方崩溃会连带上游，重要调用要显式设置 timeout。

memories.title: rebar3 常用命令
memories.content: rebar3 ct 运行 Common Test，rebar3 dialyzer 做类型检查，rebar3 as prod release 打包。

memories.title: Dialyzer 警告处理
memories.content: 新增的 dialyzer warning 在 CI 里视为失败，确实需要忽略时在代码里加 -dialyzer 属性并写明原因。

memories.title: supervisor 重启强度
memories.content: supervisor 的 intensity 和 period 设得太小会让整个应用被重启，设得太大会掩盖崩溃循环。

memories.title: 用 persistent_term 存配置
memories.content: 运行时不变的配置放进 persistent_term，更新很少，因为每次更新都会触发全局 GC。

memories.title: Prometheus 指标命名
memories.content: 指标名使用下划线，单位放在后缀，比如 request_duration_seconds。

memories.title: gRPC 反射调试
memories.content: 用 grpcurl 配合 server reflection 调用接口，生产环境默认关闭 reflection。

memories.title: certificate_expired 握手失败
memories.content: 出现 certificate_expired 通常是中间证书过期而不是服务证书，需要检查整条证书链。

memories.title: protobuf optional 字段
memories.content: 新增的 protobuf 字段必须是 optional，并且在 .proto 里写明默认值的含义。

memories.title: OTP 并发模型
memories.content: 每个请求一个 Erlang 进程，进程之间不共享内存，靠消息传递通信。

memories.title: Docker 镜像基础
memories.content: 运行时镜像基于 alpine 精简版，构建镜像包含完整的 rebar3 和编译器。

memories.title: ETS 表 public 与 protected
memories.content: ETS 表设为 public 会让任何进程都能写入，除非确实需要，否则用 protected。

memories.title: 分析 fprof 结果
memories.content: fprof 开销很大，只在预发环境对单个进程启用，分析 own 时间最高的函数。

memories.title: Redis 会话过期
memories.content: Redis 里的会话键 TTL 是 30 分钟，每次请求会续期。

memories.title: 错误码返回规范
memories.content: 对外错误统一返回 gRPC status 加 E 开头的业务码，详情放在 trailer 里。

memories.title: 大 binary 与内存释放
memories.content: 引用计数的大 binary 在进程间传递很便宜，但长期持有会让内存迟迟不释放。

memories.title: 就绪探针配置
memories.content: readiness probe 指向 /health，initialDelay 设为 10 秒，失败三次摘除流量。
